penalties.details: The Order passed under Section 270A of the Income-tax Act, 1961, for Assessment Year 2018-19 imposes a penalty of ₹1,40,531 for under-reporting of income arising from disallowance of a portion of weighted deduction claimed under Section 35(2AB) of the Act.
penalties.impact: The financial impact is limited to the penalty amount of ₹1.41 Lakhs. There is no material impact on the financial, operational or other activities of the Company.
